coordinate_notes: Positions in angstroms; no interpolation, relaxation, rotation or rescaling.
xyz_wrapped wraps only periodic axes using this frame's box.
xyz_component is bond-unwrapped per finite component, anchored at its minimum ID.
Separate components are NOT mutually image-aligned for a multi-molecule DFT cluster.
Component IDs are frame-local. Formulas do not distinguish isomers.
ReaxFF bond orders are real numbers, not assigned integer chemical bond orders.
Recorded force/charge fields, when present, are ReaxFF metadata, NOT DFT labels.
Connectivity follows saved fragment histories and qualified intervals, not an instantaneous BO cutoff.
Reference coordinates are never used as snapshot positions.
Blank bond order means not supplied; interval-average BO is not substituted for current BO.
Sparse histories are held forward as in the animation, including any saved baseline restorations.
Long connected pairs are diagnostic warnings by default; topology is not edited to shorten them.
